change: Five equality guards only: UIKit editability/font and outgoing text/selection/caret bindings.
directSourceRationale: The original updateUIView assigns the same font/editability on every update without comparison.
The original delegate writes each binding even when equal; the text setter calls project.edited(), which increments revision and persists/removes a recovery draft.
Selection is used in the inspection task identity; caret is used for suggestion placement. Avoiding equal writes removes unnecessary updates without changing new values.
evidenceLimits: Four original own-PID samples contain repeated font-update and separate scroll-to-caret setter paths.
No sampled caret-setter ancestor chain includes updateUIView. These samples do not prove the proposed synchronous cycle.
The paired log names four Studio cases when reporting state-during-update warnings, including Departure and Table, but does not provide a warning source backtrace or PID.
Apple documents textViewDidChange for user-initiated changes, not programmatic changes; this proposal does not claim the font setter calls project.edited().
Native causal improvement and original Gallery/editor acceptance remain unproven until the same original routes execute.
